story.headline: Coffee heritage from the land of Gura, Enrekang.
story.p1: On the mountain slopes of Enrekang, South Sulawesi, grows legendary Arabica beans known worldwide since the early 20th century as Enrekang Arabica. An altitude of 1,500m above sea level, fertile volcanic soil, and a cool climate impart complex flavors of floral notes, ripe berries, and a smooth body.
story.p2: COGURA was born from a desire to bring this exceptional coffee to coffee enthusiasts across the archipelago. We work directly with local farmers, meticulously managing every process from red cherry selection to roasting so authentic flavor lives in every brew.

brewingGuide.headline: How to Brew the Perfect COGURA Cup.
brewingGuide.subtitle: Recommended ratios and water temperatures to unlock the floral, ripe berry, and smooth body notes of Enrekang Arabica.

methods.name: Indonesian Tubruk
steps: Add 12g of COGURA ground coffee into a pre-warmed mug.
Pour 180 ml of hot water (let boiling water rest for 1 minute to reach ~93°C).
Stir gently 3–4 times, let it steep for 4 minutes until grounds settle, and enjoy.

methods.name: V60 / Pour Over
steps: Rinse the paper filter with hot water, then add 15g of COGURA coffee.
Bloom: pour 30–40 ml of hot water in circles and wait for 30 seconds.
Continue pouring in stages up to 225 ml, finishing around 2 minutes 30 seconds.

methods.name: French Press / Drip
steps: Add 18g of coffee into your French Press or Vietnamese Drip brewer.
Pour 270 ml of 92°C hot water and gently stir the crust.
Steep for 4 minutes, press the plunger slowly, and serve immediately.
